content:
Tessa: Quick sync  MendWell agreed to a short customer story + 30m webinar. Target week: Aug 16. Need bench, signed release, and speaker names.
Marco: I'll reach out to their PM and infra eng for co-presenting. Draft outreach ready.
Lina: Draft hero lines incoming: dev + exec variants. Hold % claims until Ravi uploads numbers.
Ravi: Bench plan: l2-7b-q4 on representative infra. Metrics: median, p95, tokens/sec at 8 concurrent streams. Will upload CSV + runbook by Aug 2.
Hana: Legal: no PHI, must sign release. Provide anonymization options for cohort counts. I'll prepare a short release template.
Omar: CSM here  I'll nudge MendWell legal to prioritize. Expect 48h turnaround.
Marco: Outreach sent at 09:08. MendWell replied: "happy to co-present, legal reviewing release, will confirm speaker names by end of week"
Tessa: Action list: Marco outreach (done), Ravi bench (due Aug 2), Lina draft assets (due Aug 5), Hana release (due Aug 3), Omar follow-up (ongoing). React :white_check_mark: to accept.
Ravi: Uploaded raw results: https://drive.example/mendwell/bench.csv and runbook: https://drive.example/mendwell/runbook.md. Warmup=300, batch=4. Please redact cohort_id per their request.
Hana: I'll include anonymize checkbox in the release. No SKUs in public copy; say "representative infrastructure."
Marco: MendWell signed and selected anonymize counts at 16:12. They approved a one-liner quote: "Redwood made real-time scoring feasible for our team."
Lina: Pushed blog + slide draft to docs: https://docs.example/mendwell-draft. Put quote placeholder in and an appendix stub for reproducibility.
Tessa: Great progress. Once redacted CSV + slides done we'll open registration T-14. promo-bot: Suggested SFDC campaign: mendwell-case-aug16; routing rule: Private/Dedicated -> Enterprise AE.
Marco: Will schedule rehearsal 2 days before.
Tessa: Thanks team  flag blockers here and I'll escalate with Omar.
